headline: Council heard update on Open Space and Recreation Plan, debriefed student climate competition, and discussed Mass Save legislation.
summary: Guest presenter Jess Wilson reviewed Lowell's Open Space and Recreation Plan, including park statistics and a new pocket park on Jackson Street. The council discussed the Student Climate Change Competition, formed a subcommittee to update its 17-page resource guide, and reviewed the Mass Save Senate bill and a support letter sent to the City Manager. Sustainability Division updates included a Tree Committee Ordinance going to City Council and a public forum on data centers.
